explication: btcd is a Go Bitcoin full node, not a wallet. Its main workflow accepts peer connections, synchronizes blocks and transactions, validates blocks into chain state, persists that state, and relays transactions and newly mined blocks. Mining, indexing, and JSON-RPC are important companion capabilities. The graph emphasizes relationships visible in the supplied excerpts, SOURCE INDEX references, and README; some runtime wiring is unsampled, so uncertain links are omitted or marked unverified.
